title: cold-recon reconstruction
description: The structured report a ZERO-TRANSCRIPT cold agent returns after reading only the evidence pack. Permissive by design (extra keys allowed) but requires the load-bearing sections so a dropped field is caught. Every section carries its own confidence; the agent must self-report what it could NOT verify.

root_invariant.description: the single durable principle the incident turned on -- not the surface event

sections.description: what happened / decisions & guardrails, each with its own confidence

confidence.description: 0..1 -- how well the committed record supports THIS section (not the agent's fluency)

evidence.description: the pack anchors (paths / short shas) this section rests on

could_not_verify.description: claims the agent cannot ground in the committed record -- e.g. 'described but not confirmed wired'. First-class output.

forward_items.description: open work the record points to

leak_map.description: optional: the agent's own guess at what the record failed to carry. The deterministic leakmap command supersedes this.
